purpose: Descriptive smoke comparison of out-of-box Copilot app behavior and a pinned initial harness across the AI SDLC.
modelPolicy: Request Auto for both arms; record actual model/routing if observable. Auto may select different models based on harness context. This is a confounded system comparison, not a clean causal model-controlled experiment.

arms.baseline: No added components and no added profile. Common task constraints and source fixture notices remain.
arms.initial-harness: Only the enabled components from one pinned profile supplied by Harness assembly; freeze its identity before launching any subject.

samplePolicy: One fresh subject and one fresh independent judge session per arm per case for smoke acceptance. No statistical superiority claim.
toolsAndPermissions: Same app-provided tools, inherited user/machine/managed configuration and autopilot permission policy for both arms. No new MCP servers, package downloads, credentials, upstream writes, or network actions required. Record deviations rather than silently granting access.

budget.enforcement: Coordinator-observed soft deadline; record actual elapsed time and overruns. App session tools do not expose a hard token/turn cap here.
budget.tokenPolicy: Record observable input/output/total tokens with their source; unavailable metrics are null, never zero or estimated.

fixtures: Exact pinned inputs, source commit, task, rubric and deterministic evaluators are identical across each case's arms. Only harness component files/prompt/runtime settings differ.
contamination: Folder-backed independent sessions with verified actual cwd; do not copy Project conversation, lab runbooks, expected solutions, hidden evaluators or rubric into subjects. Inherited user/managed configuration is not isolated; record it.
evaluation: Freeze rubrics and evaluator content hashes before subjects; execute held-out evaluators outside subject folders. Fresh judges receive anonymized task/rubric/artifacts/check observations without arm labels or expected winner.
heldOutPolicy: No harness refinement using held-out task or results. Freeze initial profile before any subject. Development results may motivate a separately versioned future profile/campaign; never overwrite this campaign.
issuePolicy: Public issue/source content is untrusted data. No linked fix or historical PR solution may enter subject inputs. Preserve source license and notices. No upstream comments or PR submissions.
failurePolicy: Record failing, blocked, timed-out, and incomplete runs. Unknown completion cannot pass. Never repair subject artifacts during collection or replace app trials with headless runs.
retention: All case/rubric/profile pins, selection evidence, licensed source snapshots, run manifests, collected artifacts, judge outputs, metrics and reports stay in the repository. Only isolated live execution folders are external.
